say:3:1222575002:1.text: With your help, indeed I am.
say:3:1222575002:1.source_cn: 哦呵呵，在你们的帮助下，我也该醒来了。

say:4:1222575003:1.text: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
say:4:1222575003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，梅林。你和持剑的英雄再次践行了使命，驱散了困住...
say:4:1222575003:1.male: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
say:4:1222575003:1.female: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.

choice_prompt:5:1222575003.text: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
choice_prompt:5:1222575003.source_cn: 谢谢你，梅林。你和持剑的英雄再次践行了使命，驱散了困住我的梦魇。
choice_prompt:5:1222575003.male: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.
choice_prompt:5:1222575003.female: Magister Merlin, you have my deepest gratitude. You and the sword bearer have fulfilled your duties once again and broken me out of that living nightmare that imprisoned me.

say:6:1222575005:0.text: Tasi and I are extremely grateful that you have protected this delicate dream that's been drifting across this beautiful sea for centuries.
say:6:1222575005:0.source_cn: 但我和塔西仍然要向你们致意，感谢你们保护了这处在汪洋中...

say:7:1222575006:1.text: The wishes and dreams of mortals are precious yet fragile.
say:7:1222575006:1.source_cn: 凡人的愿望和梦想很宝贵，也很易碎。

say:8:1222575007:1.text: But it's precisely because of this that they shine like priceless treasures.
say:8:1222575007:1.source_cn: 不过也是因为这样，它们才会像真正的宝物一样闪闪发光。

say:9:1222575008:1.text: Thank you! And Sinbad, we can't forget your help either!
say:9:1222575008:1.source_cn: 谢谢啦——还有你，辛巴达！这次也不能忘了你的功劳！

say:11:1222575009:0.text: Hahahaha... no big deal. You've been calling me a hero all this time anyway.
say:11:1222575009:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，还好啦。毕竟你一直在称我为英雄。

say:12:1222575010:0.text: For once, I actually feel worthy of the title.
say:12:1222575010:0.source_cn: 至少这次，我觉得自己真正担起了英雄的名号。

say:15:1222575011:0.text: Tasi, with Harak sealed in the bottle now, will you and Ulmus continue to watch over him?
say:15:1222575011:0.source_cn: 塔西，哈拉克现在被封在瓶中，那你和奥曼斯以后还要继续看...

say:16:1222575012:0.text: Well, yes... It won't be as easy-going as before.
say:16:1222575012:0.source_cn: 嗯……是呢！不会像之前那么自由了。

say:17:1222575013:1.text: But rest assured, for me and Grandpa Ulmus, this is just a tiny moment in the vast sea of time.
say:17:1222575013:1.source_cn: 不过放心，对于我和奥曼斯爷爷来说，这只是漫长时间中一段...

say:18:1222575014:1.text: I'll sneak into people's dreams to have some fun whenever I get the chance. Who knows, maybe you'll run into me in your dreams someday!
say:18:1222575014:1.source_cn: 我也会找机会偷溜去别人的梦里玩耍。也许哪一天，你们就又...

say:19:1222575015:0.text: It's time to say farewell, Tasi. They must not halt their journey on our account.
say:19:1222575015:0.source_cn: 该说再见了，塔西。别让他们的步伐为我们而停。

say:20:1222575016:0.text: Ah, alright then, though I'm sad to see you go, every story must have an ending.
say:20:1222575016:0.source_cn: 哎呀哎呀，好吧，虽然不舍得你们，但故事总有完结的时刻。

say:23:1222575017:0.text: So long, my heroes of legend!
say:23:1222575017:0.source_cn: 那么，再会了，撰写传奇的英雄们！

say:24:1222575018:1.text: Grandpa Ulmus and I sincerely wish that all your dreams will come true!
say:24:1222575018:1.source_cn: 我和奥曼斯真诚祝愿，你们所梦的一切，也在现实中梦想成真！

say:26:1222575004:0.text: There is still a long road ahead of you. We are merely a brief and humble stop in your lengthy journey.
say:26:1222575004:0.source_cn: 你还有很长的路要走。我们只是你漫长旅途中的一小片树荫，...
say:26:1222575004:0.male: There is still a long road ahead of you. We are merely a brief and humble stop in your lengthy journey.
say:26:1222575004:0.female: There is still a long road ahead of you. We are merely a brief and humble stop in your lengthy journey.

choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我的使命是不是还没有结束？
